steps.title: Try the interaction
body: Move either coordinate slider. The solid teal arrow shows the input vector; the dashed orange arrow shows the result of the displayed matrix.
Enter the two coordinates of the orange arrow, then check the result. The wording you see here comes directly from this placeholder specification.

visual.title: Vector plane
visual.description: Two arrows share the origin. The solid arrow tracks the input coordinates. The dashed arrow animates to the matrix output when a slider changes. Exact current coordinates are also shown below the diagram.

invalid.text: This placeholder expects a finite number in each coordinate field. Enter both coordinates, then check again.

correct.text: Both coordinates match the computed matrix output. This is the authored success response for the technical demonstration.

x-correct.text: The x coordinate matches. The y coordinate does not match the current output. This response was selected from the authored x-only feedback.

y-correct.text: The y coordinate matches. The x coordinate does not match the current output. This response was selected from the authored y-only feedback.

incorrect.text: Neither coordinate matches the current output. Try another entry or inspect the demonstration fixture.

steps.title: An authored branch
body: This optional branch exists to demonstrate a transition chosen by the specification. Returning starts the interaction again at its authored initial vector, (2, 1).
For that initial vector, the displayed matrix produces (4, 1). These are fixture values for checking the software, not an approved teaching sequence.

steps.title: Technical demonstration complete
